common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original character design candidate for Refrain, Mina's full dragon transformation. One complete character only. Build from these references, not any previous generated dragon.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is ONLY the anatomy plan: a BIPEDAL upright dragon, two legs under the pelvis, two independent arms, and a separate pair of wings growing from the back. Do not copy its colors, face, proportions or art style. Image 2 is Mina herself: black, midnight navy and white, clear blue eyes with the same quietly sorrowful lowered upper eyelids, and a blue chest jewel. Images 3,4,5 define the exact game art style and overall character scale: delicate colored linework, soft cel shading with restrained highlights, expressive anime faces, moderate stylization, large readable decorative shapes. Match ONE individual character from each sheet, not the size of the whole sheet. Do not make Mina more realistic, giant or micro-detailed than these three.
MANDATORY ANATOMY: TWO-LEGGED DRAGON, not a quadruped. Chest above a distinct waist and pelvis, pelvis above two sturdy thighs and knees. She could stand upright on these two hind feet. TWO ARMS that clearly read as shoulders, outward-bent elbows, wrists and opened dragon HANDS with separate fingers and palms, NOT dangling front paws or weight-bearing forefeet. The palms face slightly inward/upward, one reaching forward, the other closer to the chest, unmistakably arms rather than four walking legs. Wings are completely separate from these arms, rooted behind the shoulders. Body is dragon-scaled, not a humanoid wearing a dragon suit, with a compact torso and a readable dragon muzzle. Head must NOT be reduced in size; use expressive head proportions consistent with references 3-5. No wolf body, no long horizontal four-legged torso, no wyvern with wing-arms, no very long serpentine neck.
MINA IDENTITY: Charcoal BLACK main body with deep navy shading, a restrained ivory throat/belly accent, clear blue eyes and a single blue diamond chest jewel. Calm sorrowful eyes exerting determination, closed mouth, no grin or snarling monster. A few smoothly swept-back dark cranial plates frame her eyes like Mina's face framing, but no literal human wig, maid hat, dress, sleeves, or ruffles pasted onto her body. Her white-and-navy maid identity should be read MOST STRONGLY in the design of the broad wing membranes. Dragon wing finger supports remain clearly visible, no butterfly wing silhouette, no feathers.
ACTION: She is flying with ALL HER STRENGTH, visibly beating her wings, not posing with static spread wings and not passively floating. Weight and effort must be expressed through the wing stroke, lifted chest and shoulders, bent wing elbows, and flexing membranes. Torso remains upright or only modestly tilted forward. Both knees are bent, two feet off the ground under/behind her pelvis; arms gesture rather than walk. Tail curls near her body so the character stays compact. Airborne character only; no ground, no landing.
OUTPUT: Full-body single character facing left in a readable three-quarter view, same moderate stylization as the three game creatures. Entire horns, wings and tail within frame with 8 percent clear margin. Composition suitable for a compact gameplay sprite; large wings but not an enormous body. Transparent PNG alpha background. No scenery, floor, shadows, aura, gradient backdrop, particles, text, labels or watermark. Use no previous dragon designs.

candidates.variant_prompt: VARIANT A: Broad rounded-triangular bat-membrane wings with three strong structural fingers per wing. Midnight navy membranes have a prominent continuous ivory scalloped rim recalling Mina's white apron hem, with only a few fine ivory fold-like divisions inside. No literal fabric attached. Catch the POWERFUL DOWNSTROKE: wings have just swept down and outward, leading edges braced, curved trailing membranes visibly flexing backward from air resistance. Wing tips are substantially below their shoulder roots, not an idle horizontal spread. Chest lifts with effort, body is clearly upright bipedal and hands are active. This candidate emphasizes the recognizable white border and vigorous wingbeat.

VARIANT B: Taller curved triangular dragon wings, with the same three-finger bone anatomy but broader ivory fan-shaped inner membrane sections alternating with navy panels; a dark outer rim keeps the wings clearly dragon-like. A subtle fan rhythm recalls Mina's white pleats without attaching clothing. Catch the TOP OF A STRONG WINGBEAT: both muscular wing elbows raised HIGH ABOVE the shoulders, membranes pulled taut and folded slightly inward, about to powerfully push down. The bipedal chest rises, pelvis and two bent knees tuck slightly under the waist. Hands are clearly independent reaching arms, not paws. This candidate emphasizes Mina's white wing pattern and the forceful high upstroke. No gigantic butterfly silhouette.

VARIANT C: Deep BLACK/navy dragon wing upper surfaces with restrained ivory edging, broader ivory undersides revealed by an energetic bank; simpler dark silhouette than A and B. Three clear wing finger supports and a few blue jewel-like line accents only. Catch an ASYMMETRIC WINGBEAT WHILE TURNING: the nearer wing powerfully presses down and forward, the far wing is high and flexed, visible curved membrane tension shows she is straining to stay aloft and turn. Keep the bipedal torso mostly upright, slightly leaning into the turn, two distinct bent legs under the pelvis, one open hand extending for balance and the other close to the chest. The wings, not running legs, propel her. Tail curls with the turn. This candidate emphasizes a strong airborne twisting gesture and Mina's restrained black/white palette.
